mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near the Verona Area High School with the temperature at 48 degrees and the moon in a waxing gibbous phase.
In city news, the Finance Department has adopted the 2027 budget. Also, a reminder from Public Works to properly dispose of fats, oils, and greases to avoid costly sewer clogs in our community.

We have a busy schedule ahead! Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or check out ART House 360. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia events next week.
Looking at the police report, on November 2, officers were called to the 100 block of West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
It is time for dessert! Today's flavor is Double Strawberry, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
